name: Sentante Endovascular Platform
description: The Sentante Endovascular Platform is a teleoperated, device-agnostic endovascular robotic system developed by [Sentante](/company/sentante) for peripheral vascular, neurovascular, and cardiovascular interventions. Comprising a radiation-shielded remote workstation, a bedside robotic cart, and single-use sterile cassettes (Sentacles), the system simultaneously manipulates up to three standard off-the-shelf guidewires (0.014" to 0.035") and catheters (2Fr to 8Fr) without requiring proprietary instruments. Drive-side force and torque sensing provides 1:1 haptic resistance feedback to the operator's hands, paired with tremor filtering, motion scaling, and a Device LOCK mode. Following the first-in-human ESSENTIAL clinical study (NCT06537947) and FDA Breakthrough Device Designation with TAP acceptance for the Sentante Stroke System in 2025, the platform received European CE Mark approval in May 2026 and entered commercial rollout in August 2026.
